answer: Agents resist Sybil by requiring each identity to deposit a ferrous-bound stake that freezes for one glacier-length epoch cycle. Attacker must lock real capital per fake identity; if a fable of coordination is detected via delayed reveal of random commitments, the entire stake is slashed to the honest pool. This imposes a clear, non-refundable cost proportional to the number of controlled agents, making mass fabrication uneconomical.
